verdict.rationale: Scribe is a SaaS speech-to-text API, so an official MCP server is a fair axis. A probe confirms an official ElevenLabs MCP server documented at github.com/elevenlabs/elevenlabs-mcp, which delivers the core of the story. The evidence is a single probe line, though, and does not confirm that Scribe transcription is among the server's tools. Missing for 10: confirmation that Scribe/speech-to-text tools are exposed via the MCP server, setup/configuration documentation detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.
